Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming:
- Bank details will be uploaded securely via your vendor portal (we can submit via the Drive link you shared or through your portal).
- Implementation fees: we usually issue staged milestone invoices (50% kickoff, 30% mid-delivery, 20% acceptance). We can consolidate if you prefer a single invoice.
- Recurring usage invoices: monthly, generated on the first business day after month close.

We can offer an early-pay discount for the recurring invoices if Redwood opts into Net 30 for that lane. Our standard commercial offer is 1.25% if paid within 10 days (Net10) or 0.75% if paid within 15 days. For a Net30 election we can do a fixed 0.5% discount applied to the recurring invoice subtotal. If you need a higher band (1%+), I need to escalate to our CFO.

I've re-attached Sample_Invoice_Jul2025.pdf showing how we reference the PO on usage lines, and Octagon_W9.pdf for your records.

Attachments: Sample_Invoice_Jul2025.pdf, Octagon_W9.pdf

Best,
Cecilia

Subject: internal: Octagon payment lane recommendation

Quick internal — recommend the following approach so we don't block onboarding while AP evaluates discount: 

- Set implementation/milestone invoices on Net 45 (no early-pay for those).
- Put recurring usage on Net 45 by default but enable a 60-day early-pay pilot where Redwood can move those recurring invoices to Net 30 for the pilot if Octagon signs the pilot addendum. Pilot terms: 60 days, 0.9% early-pay discount for payments within 15 days, auto-revert to Net 45 after pilot unless both sides agree to change permanently.

Rationale: keeps cashflow predictable for Finance while giving Octagon a path to better economics if they want faster payment. If David confirms ACH setup is straightforward, we can offer the pilot right away.
